title: Industrial Planker

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Changes processed logs into planks, increasing the price.

body:
"Can be used to turn processed logs, into a planked material!"

Description

The Industrial Planker is a machine that can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $45,000. It converts sanded logs into planks; it is the woodworking counterpart to the Industrial Forge, increasing the sell price of wood.

Note: the Statistic Tool falsely purports not, but the Industrial Planker does increase the price of wood.

Appearance

The Industrial Planker has a very similar look to metalworking machinery, sporting a control panel that can be used to modify the output size of planks. It shares the same colouring and material used on the Industrial Forge.

  • If an object blocking the output, it will not produce (same with forgers and plankers).
    • During blockage it will save entered materials (the amount of them is shown in stat info menu), after removing blockage it will produce all queued materials from first entered to last entered.
